name: print-social-explore-your-creativity-pottery-posts-navy-teal-checker
title: 'Explore your Creativity' pottery workshop pack in navy with teal checker borders and script headlines
whatItIs: Four navy square posts with teal checkerboard corner borders, circular photos of hands shaping pottery and painting, white script headlines ('Explore your Creativity', 'Makers of beauty, Colors, Creativity & Great Stories'), a diamond date badge ('08 OCT'), sunburst icons and bold orange 'Subscribe now!' and 'Creativity Workshop' tags.
whatItMeans: Crafted and inviting; the checkerboard border and script type make a pottery workshop feel like a warm, artisanal brand.
techniques: Frame photo corners with a small checkerboard pattern.
Crop process photos into circles for an intimate feel.
Pair script headlines with bold sans CTAs for contrast.

vocabulary.definition: A small repeating two-colour square pattern used as a frame accent.
An image showing a craft being made, not the finished product.
